description: Thesis: clean thesis.* fields and GeoLocation for Nextcloud alerts (decision 0009). Called by a pipeline processor appended to Wazuh's filebeat-*-wazuh-alerts-pipeline (setup.sh adds it). Every step ignores failures: an enrichment problem must never stop an alert from being indexed. Wazuh stores data.status as a string (static field), so it is parsed here.

script.source: def d = ctx.data; if (!(d instanceof Map)) { return; } Map t = new HashMap(); String loc = ctx.location; String src = loc.endsWith('audit.log') ? 'audit' : (loc.endsWith('access.log') ? 'proxy' : 'app'); t.put('source', src); def req = d.get('request'); String uri = null; String method = null; String ip = null; if (src == 'proxy' && req instanceof Map) { ip = req.get('client_ip'); uri = req.get('uri'); method = req.get('method'); def h = req.get('headers'); if (h instanceof Map && h.get('User-Agent') instanceof List && h.get('User-Agent').size() > 0) { t.put('user_agent', h.get('User-Agent').get(0)); } } else { ip = d.get('remoteAddr'); uri = d.get('url'); method = d.get('method'); def ua = d.get('userAgent'); if (ua != null && ua != '--') { t.put('user_agent', ua); } } if (ip != null && ip != '' && ip != '--') { t.put('client_ip', ip); } String path = uri; if (path != null) { int q = path.indexOf('?'); if (q >= 0) { path = path.substring(0, q); } } String user = d.get('user'); if (user == null || user == '' || user == '--') { user = null; String dav = '/remote.php/dav/files/'; if (path != null && path.startsWith(dav)) { String rest = path.substring(dav.length()); int s = rest.indexOf('/'); user = s >= 0 ? rest.substring(0, s) : rest; } else { String msg = d.get('message'); if (msg != null && msg.startsWith('Login ')) { int a = msg.indexOf('"'); int b = a >= 0 ? msg.indexOf('"', a + 1) : -1; if (b > a) { user = msg.substring(a + 1, b); } } } } if (user != null && user != '') { t.put('user', user); } String res = null; if (src == 'audit') { String smsg = d.get('message'); if (smsg != null && smsg.startsWith('The file "')) { int sa = 10; int sb = smsg.indexOf('"', sa); if (sb > sa) { String sp = smsg.substring(sa, sb); if (user == null && sp.startsWith('/')) { int su = sp.indexOf('/', 1); if (su > 1) { user = sp.substring(1, su); t.put('user', user); } } if (user != null) { String spre = '/' + user + '/files'; res = sp.startsWith(spre) ? sp.substring(spre.length()) : sp; } else { res = sp; } } } } if (src == 'audit') { String msg = d.get('message'); if (msg != null && msg.startsWith('File') && msg.endsWith('"') && msg.length() > 2) { int e = msg.length() - 1; int b = msg.lastIndexOf('"', e - 1); if (b >= 0) { res = msg.substring(b + 1, e); if (user != null) { String pre = '/' + user + '/files'; if (res.startsWith(pre)) { res = res.substring(pre.length()); } } } } } else if (src == 'proxy' && path != null && path.startsWith('/remote.php/dav/files/')) { String rest = path.substring('/remote.php/dav/files/'.length()); int s2 = rest.indexOf('/'); res = s2 >= 0 ? rest.substring(s2) : '/'; } if (res != null && res != '') { t.put('resource', res); } List groups = ctx.rule instanceof Map && ctx.rule.get('groups') instanceof List ? ctx.rule.get('groups') : new ArrayList(); boolean web = path == '/login' || path == '/index.php/login'; String action = null; String outcome = null; if (src == 'proxy') { def st = d.get('status'); def code = null; if (st instanceof Number) { code = st.intValue(); } else if (st instanceof String && st.length() == 3 && Character.isDigit(st.charAt(0)) && Character.isDigit(st.charAt(1)) && Character.isDigit(st.charAt(2))) { code = Integer.parseInt(st); } if (code != null) { t.put('http_status', code); outcome = code < 400 ? 'success' : 'failure'; } boolean isDav = path != null && path.startsWith('/remote.php/dav/files/'); if (isDav) { Map m = ['GET': 'download', 'PUT': 'upload', 'PROPFIND': 'list', 'MKCOL': 'mkdir', 'MOVE': 'rename', 'DELETE': 'delete']; action = m.containsKey(method) ? m.get(method) : 'dav_other'; } else if (web && method == 'POST') { action = 'login'; outcome = null; } else if (path == '/logout' || path == '/index.php/logout') { action = 'logout'; } else if (path != null && path.startsWith('/ocs/v2.php/apps/files_sharing')) { action = 'share'; } else { action = 'http'; } def sim = d.get('sim_time'); if (sim != null && sim != '') { t.put('sim_time', sim); } } else if (src == 'audit') { if (groups.contains('nc_auth_success') || groups.contains('nc_auth_failure') || groups.contains('nc_auth_attempt')) { action = web ? 'login' : 'auth'; outcome = groups.contains('nc_auth_failure') ? 'failure' : (groups.contains('nc_auth_success') ? 'success' : null); } else if (groups.contains('nc_logout')) { action = 'logout'; outcome = 'success'; } else if (groups.contains('nc_file_write')) { action = method == 'PUT' ? 'upload' : (method == 'MKCOL' ? 'mkdir' : 'write'); outcome = 'success'; } else if (groups.contains('nc_file_access')) { action = method == 'GET' ? 'download' : 'access'; outcome = 'success'; } else if (groups.contains('nc_file_delete')) { action = 'delete'; outcome = 'success'; } else if (groups.contains('nc_file_rename')) { action = 'rename'; outcome = 'success'; } else if (groups.contains('nc_share')) { action = 'share'; outcome = 'success'; } else { action = 'other'; } } else { action = groups.contains('nc_bruteforce') ? 'bruteforce_detected' : 'app_log'; } boolean view = true; String vmsg = d.get('message'); if (src == 'proxy') { def hs = t.get('http_status'); view = (action == 'list' || (outcome == 'failure' && action != 'http' && action != 'login')) && !(hs != null && hs == 401); } else if (src == 'audit') { if (vmsg != null && vmsg.indexOf('" created: "') > 0 && method == 'PUT') { view = false; } if (vmsg != null && vmsg.indexOf('" written to: "') > 0 && method == 'MKCOL') { view = false; } if (action == 'logout' && !(path == '/logout' || path == '/index.php/logout')) { view = false; } if ((action == 'login' || action == 'auth') && outcome == null) { view = false; } if (action == 'auth' && outcome == 'success') { view = false; } if (action == 'other') { view = false; } } else { view = action == 'bruteforce_detected'; } t.put('view', view); if (action != null) { t.put('action', action); } if (outcome != null) { t.put('outcome', outcome); } ctx.thesis = t;

geoip.if: ctx.GeoLocation == null && ctx.thesis instanceof Map && ctx.thesis.client_ip != null
